description_en: Queries the evaluation results of a rule for resources in a specified account group
description_zh: 从规则维度查询指定账号组内规则对资源的评估结果
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-config-rule-evaluation-results --compliance-type NON_COMPLIANT --next-token IWBjqMYSy0is7zSMGu160000 --max-results 10 --config-rule-id cr-888f626622af00ae0000 --aggregator-id ca-b1e6626622af00cb0000 --compliance-pack-id cp-f1e3326622af00cb0000 --regions cn-shanghai --resource-types ACS::ECS::Instance --resource-group-ids rg-aek2cqyzvuj0000 --resource-account-id 1009318965420000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateConfigRuleEvaluationResults

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:

- COMPLIANT: The resource is compliant.

- NON\_COMPLIANT: The resource is non-compliant.

- NOT\_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resource.

- INSUFFICIENT\_DATA: No data is available.

- IGNORED: The evaluation result is ignored
parameters.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
- COMPLIANT：合规。
- NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
- NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
- IGNORED：已忽略
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is returned when the response is truncated. Use this token in the next request to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For more information about how to obtain a rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a compliance package, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource resides. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 评估资源所属的地域，多个地域之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: regions

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 评估资源的资源类型，多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the resource belongs. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 评估资源所属的资源组ID，多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource in the account group belongs.

> Specify this parameter or \`ResourceOwnerId\`. We recommend that you specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
账号组内待查询资源所属的阿里云账号ID。 
> 参数ResourceAccountId和ResourceOwnerId二选一，推荐使用本参数
parameters.name: resource_account_id
